title: Are Barcelona’s climate shelters accessible to vulnerable residents? A mobility justice analysis
core_idea: Assess whether Barcelona's network of climate shelters is equitably accessible to vulnerable residents by applying a mobility justice framework; evaluate spatial and temporal accessibility within a 10-minute walk at a reduced walking speed and analyze neighbourhood socioeconomic profiles and intersectional vulnerabilities (income, migrant background) using GIS-based isochrone analysis.
tldr: Uses mobility justice and GIS isochrone analysis to evaluate spatial and temporal access to Barcelona's climate shelters for adults 65+ and other vulnerable groups, and to examine socioeconomic patterns of access.
